classRecipes.label: FPV Scout
classRecipes.description: A nimble FPV quad. Scan shows enemy direction hints for four seconds; it never captures territory or slows an enemy.

metadata.description: Recreate the supplied neon arena: seven blue slowing regions, six red lethal regions, two roaming pink orbs, a central diamond eroder and three cyan perimeter patrols. Capture 75%. Blue ground slows your craft; red ground is lethal until captured. The central revealed islands are safe return surfaces. Grid and starting positions are scaled from the picture; enemy behaviors and speeds are authored approximations.

Four chambers divided by solid cyan walls. Yellow bouncers occupy the upper-right and lower-left chambers; pink diamond eroders occupy the other two. Four cyan patrols travel the outer safe border. Start at bottom center, move sideways before entering a chamber, and reconnect each cut to the outer safe border. Walls block movement and do not close a cut. Reveal 75%. Layout and actor positions follow the supplied screenshot; speeds and behaviors use existing Classic rules.

Seven red heart hazards surround a broken cyan heart wall. Red tiles are lethal until captured; cyan walls block movement and cannot close a cut. Enter through the side openings to reach the central revealed safe ground. Eight pink field bouncers threaten unfinished lines; two cyan patrols travel the border. Start at bottom center and reveal 75%. Geometry and initial positions follow the supplied picture, scaled to 72 × 36; motion uses existing Classic behavior.

A dense red-hazard labyrinth with cyan stepped dividers, corner recesses and central U-shaped bays. Cyan walls block movement and do not close a cut. Red ground is lethal until captured. Six purple bouncers threaten unfinished lines; two cyan patrols travel the outer safe rail. Start at bottom center, move sideways out of the bay, and find a clear entry before cutting. Reveal 75%. Layout follows the supplied screenshot; tile scaling and enemy motion use existing Classic rules.

A lattice of red arrow hazards surrounds fourteen short cyan walls. Red ground is lethal until captured; cyan walls block movement and cannot close a cut. Four yellow bouncers roam the field while four cyan patrols travel the safe perimeter. Start at bottom center, weave between the arrows, and reconnect to safe ground to reveal 75%.

Three stepped cyan chambers contain nested open boxes, narrow passages and offset crossbars. Cyan walls block movement and cannot close a cut. Six yellow bouncers roam the field and four cyan patrols start along the top border. Start at bottom center, move sideways around the central wall, and reconnect to the safe outer rail to reveal 75%.
